threat_actors.note: Flag counts per publisher account, not adjudicated malicious counts. The former `malware_campaign.confirmed_malware` field is removed: it held 751 (an OpenClaw-only flag total) until 2026-06-14, then 552, described in commit 3747e149 as 'confirmed after manual review'. 552 is reproducible from data/public-blacklist.json, but it is a publisher attribution rather than a review -- it is exactly the entries belonging to hightower6eu (354/354) and sakaen736jih (198/198), all matching the single rule ATR-2026-00121, while 125 other hits on that rule are marked unconfirmed only because the publisher differs. The third actor named in the campaign report has no blacklist entries at all.

_provenance_warning: This report pairs a FOUR-source total with a FIVE-source breakdown, so its own numbers do not reconcile. `totals.scanned` 96,096 is the four SKILL.md registries only: OpenClaw 56,480 + ClawHub 36,378 + Skills.sh 3,115 + Hermes 123. The `sources` block below instead lists five sources -- adding MCP Registry 4,880 and recording ClawHub as 36,498 -- and sums to 101,096. `severity` likewise sums to 1,349 against `totals.flagged` 1,302. The authoritative record is data/full-scan-v2-2026-04-14.json: 101,280 scanned / 1,434 flagged, engine v2.0.0, every subtotal closing. 96,096 and 101,280 are different scopes, not competing counts -- quote 101,280/1,434 outward, and say 'excluding MCP Registry' whenever the narrower figure is used.
